subject: Day-of playbook + ops bridge coordination for SOC 2 / pen-test / DPA review
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@vaultbank.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: security@vaultbank.com, priya.raman@vaultbank.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 / pen test day-of — ops coordination

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the compliance intake. We're lining up the day-of activities for next Thursday (7/22) and want to confirm how Redwood prefers to run the SOC2/pen-test/DPA readout so we can map internal stakeholders. Main asks:

- Who will join from Redwood (roles, names) and which times they can present?
- Do you have a short "day-of playbook" or runbook we can review ahead of time?
- Ops bridge (Zoom + logging) — will Redwood host or should VaultBank proctor?

We have Priya (head of security), and our external pen vendor may join for the first 45m. Looking to lock a 90-minute window with an ops bridge + a short evidence-transfer checklist.

Appreciate a pointer to your preferred format and any times that work.

Tom
Tom Alvarez
Director, Security Operations
VaultBank Inc.

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@vaultbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 / pen test day-of — ops coordination

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. Happy to run the day-of and host the ops bridge. Quick answers inline then a proposed plan: 

- Redwood attendees: myself (Security & Compliance PM), Marissa Cole (Customer Engineering — evidence & playbook walk-through), Ben Carter (Account lead for post-readout commercial items). Camila Reyes (Ops) will run the bridge and monitoring.

- Playbook: we have a concise day-of playbook (15–18 pages) that covers run order, escalation contacts, evidence locations, and a sample script for the pen vendor. I can share a PDF and a short Drive link.

- Ops bridge: Redwood will host the bridge (Zoom + ephemeral recording off). We'll provide an ops-bridge invite and a small, pre-seeded channel for live log handoff if needed.

Proposed windows on Thu 22 Jul (all PT):
1) 09:30–11:00 (preferred) — allows vendor morning slot
2) 13:00–14:30 — alternative if you need to consolidate other meetings

Next steps: pick a window, confirm attendees, and tell us whether you prefer pre-uploaded evidence to our secure transfer or an SFTP pull. I'll attach the playbook stub and the ops-bridge .ics once we lock time.

cheers,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Security & Compliance PM
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@vaultbank.com>

Cc: priya.raman@vaultbank.com, security@vaultbank.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:21:00 -0700

Thanks Stephanie — 09:30–11:00 PT on Thu 7/22 works for us. Attendees:

- Priya Raman (Head of Security)
- Myself (Tom Alvarez)
- External pen vendor (DeepProbe Labs) — they'll join first 45m for the technical readout
- Two product managers (TBD)

For evidence transfer: we prefer Redwood to host a short-lived secure link (we cannot open inbound SFTP from our side for this engagement). If you can post the pre-read artifacts to a time-limited Drive link or secure transfer page that would be ideal.

Can you also include a short bullet list of the handoff steps you expect on the call (e.g., where to share artifacts, who drives remediation notes, how to confirm closure)?

Tom

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@vaultbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 / pen test day-of — ops coordination

Tom — great, locking 09:30–11:00 PT on 2027-07-22. Attached are the short artifacts and the ops-bridge invite: redwood_dayof_playbook_v1.pdf, ops-bridge-invite.ics, evidence-transfer-instructions.txt. For quick visibility here's the day-of handoff checklist (bullet form):

- Start (0–5m): introductions + run order (Stephanie)
- Vendor readout (5–50m): vendor presents findings; Redwood takes clarifying questions
- Evidence handoff (50–65m): Vendor or VaultBank uploads artifacts to our secure transfer link; Marissa confirms receipt and maps items to controls
- Triage & owners (65–80m): Marissa assigns remediation owners and timelines; Ben notes any procurement/commercial follow-ups
- Wrap & next steps (80–90m): schedule post-mortem and evidence retention/validation cadence

Evidence note: the secure transfer link will expire 72 hours after it is created. We'll provide the link 24 hours before the call. If VaultBank needs a different retention window, let me know.

Camila will send the Zoom bridge and calendar invite (you should see an invite from camila_reyes@redwood.com shortly). If Priya or the vendor needs an extra 15m pre-brief with our engineer, flag it and we can add a pre-call at 09:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Stephanie

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
